liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Echoes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [3]

## The recordings

- **ween1995-09-09** (recommended): source not stated; 1 songs; 30 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says footage suggests Aaron Freeman (Gener) on keys and backing vocals, and Mickey Malchiondo (Deaner) on guitar [2]
- Footage suggests Bill Folwer played lead guitar and sang, and Marc Carney played drums [2]
- Bass was by George Altonen, plus either Chris Williams or Andrew Weiss; the reviewer can't tell which from the footage [2]
